jobs.company: Rodlx Technologies LLC act Roadside assistance and Car Care on Demand
jobs.title: Founder & CEO
jobs.description:
Company Description
Rodlx Technologies LLC is an emerging technology-driven company focused on providing roadside assistance and car care on demand. Based in Hockley, TX, the company aims to simplify vehicle support through convenient, reliable, and customer-centered services. Using digital tools and streamlined processes, Rodlx Technologies LLC seeks to connect drivers with rapid assistance and maintenance solutions. Team members have the opportunity to help shape a growing mobility services platform and influence how drivers experience roadside and car care services.
Role Description
The Founder & CEO will provide strategic leadership, set the company vision, and drive the growth of Rodlx Technologies LLC’s roadside assistance and on-demand car care services. This full-time hybrid role is based in Hockley, TX, with flexibility for some work from home. Day-to-day responsibilities include defining business strategy, overseeing operations, managing budgets, and ensuring high-quality customer experiences. The Founder & CEO will build and lead the core team, establish partnerships, and engage with investors, vendors, and other stakeholders. The role also involves monitoring market trends, guiding product and service development, and ensuring compliance with relevant regulations and industry standards.
Qualifications

Demonstrated leadership experience in building, scaling, or managing a business, ideally in automotive, mobility, logistics, or technology services.
Strong capabilities in strategic planning, business development, and financial management, including budgeting and performance tracking.
Experience overseeing operations and customer service, with a focus on service quality, process efficiency, and continuous improvement.
Ability to develop partnerships with vendors, service providers, and community stakeholders; experience with negotiations and contract management is beneficial.
Comfort with technology platforms and digital tools used for service coordination, customer communication, and data-driven decision making.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to lead teams, collaborate cross-functionally, and represent the company externally.
Entrepreneurial mindset, problem-solving skills, and resilience in a dynamic, early-stage environment.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, Engineering, or a related field is preferred; equivalent experience in founding or leading organizations will be considered.

jobs.title: Regional Director of Operations
jobs.description:
Description

JOB SUMMARY:

The Regional Operations Director directly supervises and coordinates activities of multiple assigned practices and supports Practice Managers in managing day-to-day operations. Responsible for profit & loss and overall success of the assigned practices in the local market. This support is crucial to the delivery of the company's mission of helping children achieve a lifetime of great oral health.

Education/Credentials/Experience

Bachelor's degree in healthcare or related field, Master's degree preferred
5+ years of experience in healthcare operations management
Multi-site management experience, required

Job-related Skills/Competencies

Understanding of all policies and procedures pertaining to dental/orthodontic operations, revenue cycle, marketing and any administrative functions.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Exceptional customer service and communication skills.
Excellent interpersonal and leadership skills.
Ability to work with diverse groups of individuals.
Excellent follow-up skills, interpersonal skills, strong analytical and problem solving abilities.
Strong group presentation skills.
Basic understanding of financial statements.
Ability to travel to assigned dental/orthodontic offices.

Major Duties And Responsibilities

Implements and ensures ongoing compliance with all operational policies, procedures, and training programs, in all assigned dental/orthodontic offices.
Responsible for operational and financial performance of all assigned dental/orthodontic offices, as defined in the budgetary process.
Responsible for high level oversight of all assigned facilities related projects, included but not limited to, office relocations, remodels, de novo set-up etc.
Responsible for oversight of new affiliations within the assigned region.
Reviews and analyzes operating statements on a monthly basis to ensure dental/orthodontic office objectives are met.
Reviews dental/orthodontic offices operating systems and available operational reports to ensure ongoing process improvement.
Provides support to Practice Managers and support staff for compliance with regulations, in accordance current company and/or other regulatory requirements.
Monitors, evaluates and recommends changes to policies and procedures to enhance service.
Supports Clinical Director to identify and resolve problems with service to customers.
Assists Operations in preparing and maintaining annual budgets for assigned practices.
Coordinates involvement of dental/orthodontic leadership teams in the budget process in conjunction with other market leadership team members.
Monitors marketplace trends and gathers competitive information, in conjunction with marketing leadership.
Facilitates the implementation of and ensures adherence to all corporate policies, procedures and initiatives.
Assist the Practice Managers with the hiring, training and development of all support staff.
Hires, trains and develops Practice Managers.
Coordinates with the Practice Managers the staffing on a daily basis, based on budgetary, patient flow, employee illness and other relevant factors.
Coordinates vendor selection in order to minimize the cost of out-sourced services.
Assists with resolution of customer issues.
Performs other duties as assigned.
